[[File:Sun_skimmer_2000_sun_jammer.jpg|thumb|200px|The solar collector dish on the ''[[Sun Skipper 2000 Sun Jammer]]''.]]
A '''solar collector dish''' was a system of propulsion used on ''[[Sun Skipper 2000 Sun Jammer]]''. This device worked on a similar principle to a [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sail]], in which it collected light and [[Star/Legends|solar]] wind. This system produced slow acceleration and was dependent on a star to the back of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], but it did not require fuel or power to operate.
